trigger_condition: Two persisted switches have case-distinct names Checkout and checkout and opposite active states; both are queried without clearing the shared cache.
defect_mechanism: keyfmt lowercases the name before hashing, collapsing distinct case-sensitive database identities into one cache key.
propagation_path: switch_is_active calls Switch.get; BaseModel._cache_key delegates to keyfmt; the second lookup reuses the first cached Switch.
failure_manifestation: The second switch returns the first switch's active state; isolated cold lookups remain correct.
reference_repair_behavior: Hash the original case-sensitive name without lowercasing.
